svg.aria-label: Exact vertical transport and fall endpoints

g.text: V3.1 · exact endpoints, one connection per row · not a spatial projection
Floor tags give height; coordinate tags locate each island on its floor map. Repeated names are the same island.
Two arrowheads = reversible. One arrowhead = one-way travel. E33 is the final local rise within Floor 3.
Geography is unchanged. Node boxes are separated by route so no line can end on an unrelated island.
